final_wiki.answer-Q-8095-A84:
The greatest common divisor of 420 and 720 is 60.

Calculation:
420 = 2² × 3 × 5 × 7
720 = 2⁴ × 3² × 5
GCD = 2² × 3 × 5 = 4 × 3 × 5 = 60
